diagnoses.title: agenttrail plan convention block duplicated verbatim across CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md
diagnoses.detail: The entire 13-line "agenttrail plan convention" section is byte-identical in both files. Since CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md with @AGENTS.md, both copies load into every session, paying the token cost twice for one rule.
evidence: CLAUDE.md:90-102 and AGENTS.md:69-81 are identical, including the <!-- agenttrail --> marker and every bullet.
diagnoses.prescription: Keep the agenttrail block in one file only (AGENTS.md, since CLAUDE.md already imports it) and delete the copy from CLAUDE.md.

diagnoses.title: Response-style instruction split across both files with overlapping wording
diagnoses.detail: CLAUDE.md line 3 ("Always talk in ASD-STE100... say only what needs to be said") and AGENTS.md's "Short responses" section (line 61, "Always use ASD-STE100... talk to me like I'm 5") both govern the same thing: how terse and plain replies should be.
diagnoses.prescription: Fold CLAUDE.md line 3 into AGENTS.md's "Short responses" section, or vice versa, so the tone rule lives in one place.

diagnoses.title: Rebuild-date claim cannot be checked against history
diagnoses.detail: CLAUDE.md says "Last rebuild: 2026-08-14" but both CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md are gitignored (/CLAUDE.md, /AGENTS.md in .gitignore) and untracked, so there is no commit history to confirm the date. This is a self-reported cadence, not a repo defect.
evidence: git ls-files shows neither file tracked; .gitignore lines 47-48 exclude them
diagnoses.prescription: No fix needed. If the rebuild cadence should be auditable, remove CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md from .gitignore, or track the rebuild date in a small tracked file instead.

diagnoses.title: Three vendored tool directories carry their own broken CLAUDE.md references
diagnoses.detail: ui-ux-pro-max-skill/, micode/, and superpowers/ each have their own .git and are gitignored from this repo — they are separate checked-out projects, not R+'s own instructions. Their CLAUDE.md files have many dead references (e.g. ui-ux-pro-max-skill/CLAUDE.md has 20+ missing paths) and one has un-pruned /init boilerplate, but fixing another project's memory file is out of scope here.
evidence: each dir has its own .git and is listed in .gitignore (lines 40, 42, 43)
diagnoses.prescription: No action in this repo. If these tools matter to this project, fix them in their own repos.

prescriptions.action: Delete the duplicate agenttrail block from CLAUDE.md, keeping the one in AGENTS.md
prescriptions.rationale: Removes 13 duplicated lines from every session's standing context with zero loss of instruction, since AGENTS.md is already imported.

followup: Re-run this checkup after any large edit to CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, or every 2-3 months per the file's own cadence.
